full_prompt_en: An oil-like painted portrait shows an older grey-haired man in a dark coat and white neckcloth against a rough, earth-toned background. Charcoal, muted olive and ochre strokes form an indistinct field on the left, while lighter grey-brown patches surround the upper right of his head. His head and upper chest occupy most of the frame, with the shoulders turning slightly and the face angled toward the left. Thick, loosely tousled grey hair spreads across the top, broken into pale curls and coarse darker brush marks. Below the high, lined forehead, heavy brows frame small dark eyes directed just left of the viewer. A prominent long nose, strongly modelled cheekbones, tight closed lips and a firm bare chin create a serious, intent expression. Warm cream and ochre illuminate the forehead, nose bridge and nearer cheek, with dusty rose along the cheek and cooler brown-grey shadow beneath the brow and around the far side of the face. Below his chin, a bright white neckcloth gathers into irregular folds above the pale shirt front. A high dark collar and broad blue-grey lapel frame it on the right, while the coat fades into brown-black strokes on the left. Warm directional light from the upper left creates clear highlights and a deeper shadow across the right side of the face, rather than an even frontal wash. Rough vertical and horizontal paint strokes cross the background and clothing edges, while the eyes, nose and mouth remain more tightly resolved. The overall composition holds a solid, sharply attentive face within broken painted surroundings, balancing luminous cream fabric and warm skin against muted blue-grey, olive and dark brown.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅近似油画表现的肖像描绘一位灰发年长男子，身穿深色外套与白领巾，背后是粗粝的土色背景。左侧炭灰、暗橄榄色和赭色笔触组成模糊色域，头部右上周围则铺着较浅灰棕斑块。头部与上胸占据大部分画幅，肩部略微转动，面容朝向左方。浓密松乱的灰发铺展在顶部，被分成浅色卷束与粗疏深色笔痕。带皱纹的高额头下，浓眉围着小而深的眼睛，目光落在观者稍偏左的位置。突出长鼻、起伏分明的颧骨、紧闭嘴唇和坚实无须下巴形成严肃专注的神情。暖奶油色和赭色照亮额头、鼻梁与近侧面颊，面颊带灰粉色，眉下和远侧脸周则转为较冷棕灰阴影。下巴下方，明亮白领巾在浅色衬衣前襟上方聚成不规则衣褶。右侧高深色衣领与宽蓝灰翻领围住这片白色，左侧外套融入棕黑笔触。左上方暖色方向光形成明确亮部，面部右侧落入更深阴影，而非均匀正面光。粗疏横竖画笔痕穿过背景与衣物边缘，眼、鼻、嘴则刻画得较集中清晰。整体构图以断续绘画环境包围凝实专注的面容，让明亮奶油白织物和暖肤色平衡暗蓝灰、橄榄色与深棕色。
style_prompt_en: The painterly treatment combines firmly modelled central forms with rough, broken strokes around the edges. Muted ochre, olive, blue-grey and charcoal establish an earthy palette, while cream highlights and restrained rose accents bring selected planes forward. Layered vertical and horizontal marks leave a scraped, uneven surface, alternating opaque blocks with thin translucent passages. Directional warm light defines volume through distinct bright planes and cool recessed shadows. Fine detail is concentrated near the focal area; surrounding contours partially merge into the textured field. The overall effect balances realistic solidity with visible paint handling and an asymmetrical distribution of light and dark.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画式处理将中央凝实塑形与边缘粗疏断续笔触结合。暗赭、橄榄色、蓝灰和炭灰建立土色基调，奶油色亮部及克制玫瑰色点缀将局部色面推向前方。层叠横竖笔痕留下刮擦般不均匀表面，不透明块面与薄透色层交替。温暖方向光以明确受光面和较冷凹陷阴影塑造体积。精细刻画集中于焦点附近，外围轮廓部分融入带纹理色域。整体效果将写实体量、可见画笔处理与非对称明暗分布结合。
theme_en: A serious grey-haired man in a dark coat and high white neckcloth, painted against a rough earth-toned background
theme_zh: 灰发男子穿深色外套与高白领巾，神情严肃，衬在粗粝土色背景前
name: George Miller
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
